key_insight: WorldEvolver improves long-horizon LLM planning by updating the world model at test time with memory and confidence filtering, without changing any frozen parameters.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical way to boost agent foresight and decision quality in deployment using retrieval, rule extraction, and selective prediction integration.
method: Episodic Memory: retrieve real action transitions to simulate likely outcomes.
Semantic Memory: distill recurring prediction-observation mismatches into heuristic rules.
Selective Foresight: drop low-confidence predictions before adding them to agent context.
evidence_signal: On ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, WorldEvolver achieved the highest prediction accuracy across three backbones and improved downstream success on AgentBoard versus other world model baselines.
watch_item: Because gains depend on retrieval quality and confidence calibration, noisy memory or misfiltered forecasts could still mislead the agent at deployment time.
paper_title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
